ghaelentweaks:setting-underground-radius: Underground lore creature detection radius for cat glow. Set to 0 to disable.
Underground lore creature detection radius for the cat yowl. Set to 0 to disable.
ghaelentweaks:setting-above-ground-radiu: Above-ground lore creature detection radius for cat glow. Set to 0 to disable.
Above-ground lore creature detection radius for the cat yowl. Set to 0 to disable.
ghaelentweaks:setting-enable-palisade-da: Lore creatures and charging adult bears, wolves, and hyenas take damage from palisades.
ghaelentweaks:setting-palisade-damage-am: Damage dealt each time an affected creature's palisade damage cooldown elapses.
ghaelentweaks:setting-palisade-damage-co: Seconds between palisade damage pulses for each affected creature. Range: 1 to 10.
ghaelentweaks:setting-persistent-craftin: Keeps player crafting-grid ingredients in place when closing the inventory.
ghaelentweaks:setting-tule-handbasket-co: Allows crafting the normal reed handbasket with thatch harvested from tule.
ghaelentweaks:setting-betterruins-bluepr: Allows players to read Better Ruins blueprints and craft known blueprint recipes without placing the blueprint in the grid.
ghaelentweaks:setting-display-case-stack: Allows display cases to be placed directly on top of other display cases.
